market: full-game two-way moneyline, overtime included, same provider and settlement terms
hypothesis: Official pre-decision player availability and role information improves out-of-sample log loss beyond a same-time market plus rest/travel/pace baseline.
decision: Actual freeze at or before scheduled tipoff minus 30 minutes; all input receipt completed by the earlier of freeze and T-30. Postponed, live, ambiguous and incomplete products are excluded.
candidate: One ridge logistic regression with market no-vig logit as fixed offset and standardized pre-decision fact, prior role, rest/travel and pace covariates. Fit scaling and coefficients on training only. No manually assigned probability uplift. Missing fact is missing, not healthy; eligibility requires an official pre-decision report for both teams and player identity joins.
baseline: Same offset and same eligible games, model family, training and controls, without fact/role variables; market no-vig reference and exact preserved operating decision separately. A withheld operating pick stays withheld. No 9:1 replay presented as frozen operating decision.
variables: official report bytes, URL, claimed publication and actual completed receipt times, status with confirmed-out separately from uncertain
official confirmed lineup and official minutes restriction if received before freeze, otherwise missing indicators
prior player role from earlier completed games actually received before freeze; prior non-garbage-time minutes and usage with recorded definition
previous completed game finish and venue; schedule revision and receipt for back-to-back and travel
prior non-garbage-time pace with event-level provenance
complete same-provider two-sided price vector, product, period, overtime, line, observed and received timestamps
original frozen operating decision and revision, including abstention
official result, settlement convention and actual result receipt
integrity: Never infer confirmation from probable/questionable or postgame starters; official injury status is not a confirmed lineup.
No target-game box score, playing time, pace or result enters features; earlier game data only when actually received by decision time; no hindsight garbage-time labeling.
Retain document bytes and content hashes, source and collector receipt evidence; hash alone does not independently authenticate receipt.

Compare against most recent report actually received by freeze; retain late revisions separately. Match identity and quote before outcome. Conflicting identity, revisions or time ordering fail closed.
Group exact duplicate byte hashes for the same fact and game, not distinct official revisions or matching selections; retain provenance. Detect duplicate games and repeated decisions.
Poison target and future labels, later revisions and postgame minutes and verify frozen features/predictions are unchanged; perturb prior unavailable labels as well.
split_and_gate: Before accessing any outcomes in the new dataset freeze chronological UTC train/validation/test calendar boundaries in an append-only protocol amendment and record data/event hashes; never split a game. Train >=300 eligible games, validation >=100 and held-out test >=200 with >=50 test games containing a confirmed-out fact; all outcomes used in a fit must be actually received before that fit cutoff. If either threshold or provenance fails, stop as blocked_data, no model fit or ROI. Select one of ridge penalties [1,10,100] on validation log loss, ties choose larger penalty, and choose fact candidate only if validation log loss is strictly below the no-fact baseline; otherwise stop and retain baseline. Once selected, refit on train plus validation with available results only, freeze weights and test once. No reruns on the same test or model revisions after observing it.
report: Report cohort and exclusion flow with overlap, time ranges, all arms' selections/abstentions and coverage, accuracy, unit-stake ROI with exact selected-side prices, binary log loss, Brier, result-receipt-batch maximum drawdown and paired differences; block bootstrap by game week as descriptive uncertainty. Do not apply or alter wallet rules. Drawdown does not observe intrabatch ordering. Evaluate operating arm only where exact same product, result and preserved original decision exist and report its own denominator.
stop: No independent-source receipt or full paired prices, missing report bytes, identity ambiguity, leakage, no unseen data or insufficient thresholds => blocked_data/integrity; do not substitute retrospective timestamps or construct ROI. Research only; no automatic promotion.
